governing_statement: The crucible syntax is largely formalised; statistical calibration and a stationary claimant specification are not yet complete.

added_fields.Q: quality, deduplication, cross-match and missing-data rules

actions.summary: Add P, T, E, M, Q and R to the next Sheridan contract schema.
Return CONTRACT_NOT_EXECUTABLE with unresolved primary fields instead of a scientific failure verdict.
Freeze release, schema version, units, query text, query hash and quality rules.
Measure type-I error under synthetic anisotropic skies, irregular masks and catalogue-specific failures.
Calibrate the complete radius, endpoint, node-set and predicate family with a max-statistic or declared correction.
Separate historical reproduction and diagnostic verdicts from prospective crucible verdicts.
Add frozen negative-control geometries, predicates and matched fields.
Define protected-holdout manifests covering both data independence and analyst blindness.
Specify external-custodian execution with precommitted contract, environment and holdout hashes.

boundaries: The assessment is not an independent execution of UFF.
The assessment does not validate the Logvinovich claim.
A reproducible analysis can still reproduce a biased sampling design or inappropriate null model.
Claimant clarification cannot replace independent data, calibrated nulls or a protected holdout.
